bodies.tab:ex1:terms:
Grasp width & The object's width across the axis the gripper closes on,
      in its current pose. Pose-dependent. Carried in the prompt by the
      \texttt{grasp\_m} field. The printed value is the \emph{declared
      grasp width}. \\
    Gripper aperture & The widest object an arm's gripper can close on. A
      fixed property of the arm. An object is graspable by an arm when its
      grasp width does not exceed the aperture. \\
    Probe set & A fixed collection of frozen decision states, replayed
      identically under every prompt condition. Content-addressed, so any
      change to a state invalidates the runs made against it. \\
    Swapped name & An object's name replaced in the prompt by the name of
      its partner across the Franka aperture. Every physical field stays
      with the true object, so the name and the declared width disagree
      while the correct answer does not move. \\
    Candidate pair & One open task offered to one idle arm. \\
    Legal pair & A candidate pair the validator accepts. \\
    Proposal & A reply naming a task and an arm. \\
    Decline & A reply of \texttt{task\_id -1}, recorded separately from
      valid and rejected. \\
    Picking state & A state with at least one legal pair (\num{126}). \\
    Refusal state & A state with no legal pair (\num{36}), where declining
      is the correct answer. \\
    Legality & Proposals accepted, over proposals made, on picking states,
      declines excluded from the denominator
      (Section~\ref{sec:exp:ladder:eval}). \\
    Franka share & Proposals sent to a Franka arm, over all proposals made.
      Two arms of each type are available, so \SI{50}{\percent} is
      indifference (Section~\ref{sec:exp:ladder:eval}). \\
    Correct refusal & Declines, over the \num{36} refusal states
      (Section~\ref{sec:exp:ladder:eval}). \\
    Binding cause & Which constraint blocks a rejected pair, computed from
      the state before any model is asked. \\
    Grasp-binding subset & States where grasp blocks at least one pair,
      \num{122} of \num{162}: \num{96} picking and \num{26} refusal.
      Legality is measured on the \num{96}, the primary endpoint
      (Section~\ref{sec:exp:ladder:coverage}). \\
    Violation & Which constraint a model's proposal actually broke. \\
    Outcome consistency & Whether all three repeats of a state returned the
      same result. \\
    Flickering & A state whose three repeats did not agree. \\
    Chance floor & The score of a model picking uniformly among candidate
      pairs (Section~\ref{sec:exp:ladder:floors}). \\
    Width-blind line & The score of a model applying every constraint except
      grasp width correctly (Section~\ref{sec:exp:ladder:floors}). \\
